info.title: RelayHarbor local management API
info.description: Password-authenticated HTTPS management API with Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Strict sessions and CSRF protection. Root CLI uses a peer-checked Unix socket. Bearer management tokens are no longer accepted. Setup operations run as persistent background jobs. AnyTLS retains independent revisions.
